summary: Preserved PR 2975's valid ordinary-TP entry-rank-only grammar compilation, masking, and token broadcast. Independently reproduced both review counterexamples at the candidate tree: speculative TP and context-parallel TP select the legacy path and a simulated non-entry rank submits its own grammar lookup. No further source correction is justified in the assigned one-GPU environment because speculative verification requires real per-rank FSM/tree state and context parallelism requires synchronization across a topology broader than the candidate's attn-TP groups.

tests.what_was_measured: Against the candidate implementation, simulated non-entry ranks made one grammar compile/cache lookup in both speculative-TP and CP-active-TP fallback modes; ordinary TP made zero and installed PlaceholderGrammarObject.

Candidate compatibility and regression suite: 97 passed, including ordinary-TP compile-once behavior, failure synchronization, broadcast selection, legacy all-reduce fallback, and no collective for unconstrained batches.
Changed Python modules and the independent reproducer compile successfully.

tests.command: inline torch ROCm masked-argmax reference (output retained in reports/j-109181fc89fe/raw/gpu-reference.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: On the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, masked argmax [2, 1] matched the independently constructed allowed-token reference [2, 1]. This measures mask numerics only, not distributed serving.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the numerical reference on one AMD Instinct MI355X. torch.cuda.device_count() returned 1, so TP/CP distributed serving was not executed.

remaining_limitations: TP constrained decoding with speculative decoding still compiles and applies grammar state per rank; safely changing it requires synchronizing speculative tree masks, FSM advancement, accept lengths, accept indexes, and output tokens.

TP constrained decoding with active context parallelism still compiles and applies grammar state in each applicable attention-TP group; safely changing it requires ownership and collectives spanning the combined attention CP and TP request topology.
Only one GPU was assigned, so true TP=2/TP=4, speculative TP, context-parallel TP, DP-attention distributed serving, and end-to-end overhead measurement remain unverified.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the missing distributed architectures and was not used as substitute evidence.
No native sources changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
